children: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said Tehran has proposed a seven-day plan to restore normal navigation through the Strait of Hormuz, with the decision resting with the United States. According to ChainCatcher, Araghchi said at an Organization of Islamic Cooperation meeting that Iran sent the proposal through Qatar and would reopen the strait within seven days if the conditions are met.

title: Iranian Foreign Minister Araghchi Says Strait Reopening Depends on U.S. Under Seven-Day Plan
